text: This report recommends that City Council approve the demolition of three category "X" buildings within the East Annex Heritage Conservation District (EAHCD) and approve the design of a replacement structure located at 126, 128 and 130 Avenue Road in accordance with Section 42(1) 2 and 42(1) 4 of the Ontario Heritage Act. The application is to demolish three existing buildings that form part of a row of buildings located on the west side of Avenue Road, between Bernard Avenue to the south and Davenport Road to the north. The EAHCD Plan allows for the demolition of category "X" buildings provided that the replacement building design complies with the EAHCD plan guidelines for new buildings. The demolition would allow for the construction of a new 11-storey building that meets the general intent of the EAHCD Plan's guidelines and would not detract from rated heritage buildings to the west…

City Council on July 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the demolition of the category "X" buildings at 126, 128 and 130 Avenue Road, in the East Annex Heritage Conservation District, in accordance with Section 42(1) 4 of the Ontario Heritage Act and the erection of one building in accordance with Section 42(1) 2 of the Ontario Heritage Act subject to the following: a. City Council approve the replacement building for 126, 128 and 130 Avenue Road as shown in the plans and elevations submitted by the applicant and prepared by Icon Architects dated May 8, 2025 along with the Heritage Impact Assessment prepared by ERA Architects Inc dated April 22, 2025 and on file with the Senior Manager, Heritage Planning, and that the replacement structure be constructed substantially in accordance with the submitted plans; and b. prior to the issuance of any heritage permit…
